suppress.notes: False positive — wrong product. CVE-2022-31691 (CVSS 9.8) is an RCE in the YAML editing support of *Spring Tools 4 for Eclipse* (<= 4.16.0) and the related VSCode extensions (Spring Boot Tools, Concourse CI Pipeline Editor, Bosh Editor, Cloudfoundry Manifest YML Support). It has nothing to do with the `spring-boot-devtools` library; Dependency-Check matches it on the shared `vmware:spring_boot` CPE. Independently, devtools is declared `developmentOnly`, so it is never packaged into a deployable artifact. Re-evaluate if a CVE is ever published against the devtools library itself.

False positive — version out of range. CVE-2020-29582 is the Kotlin `createTempDir`/`createTempFile` information disclosure, which affects kotlin-stdlib <= 1.4.20 and was fixed in 1.4.21. This project resolves Kotlin 2.4.10. Dependency-Check matches the JetBrains Kotlin CPE against the kotlin-stdlib-jdk7 / kotlin-stdlib-jdk8 compatibility shims and the coroutines artifact, whose own version strings it cannot map to a Kotlin release. Re-evaluate only if this project ever downgrades below Kotlin 1.4.21.

False positive — wrong artifact. CVE-2026-34481 affects `org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-layout-template-json` (>= 2.14.0, < 2.25.4). That artifact is not on any classpath here; the only log4j artifacts present are log4j-api and log4j-to-slf4j (Spring Boot's SLF4J bridge), and both are already at 2.25.4. Dependency-Check matches on the shared `apache:log4j` CPE. Re-evaluate if log4j-layout-template-json is ever introduced.

False positive — wrong artifact within the same CVE. CVE-2026-49844 is a MapMessage JSON-serialization defect in `log4j-api` itself (2.13.1–2.25.4 and 2.26.0, fixed in 2.25.5 / 2.26.1). Dependency-Check additionally attributes it to `log4j-to-slf4j`, which merely bridges the Log4j API onto SLF4J and does not carry the affected code. NOTE: this suppression is deliberately scoped to log4j-to-slf4j ONLY. The finding against log4j-api is real — we resolve 2.25.4 — and is left visible on purpose until log4j is bumped to 2.25.5.
